row.body: The travel pack is still tied shut beside a note that says the supplies are no longer needed. The departure time was entered but never initialled.
row.title: Packed but no longer needed

cites.quote: I wont need all this now

sidecar.gloss: A packed departure is left without a signed start.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field crew could abandon a pack when work ended; the note does not say whether anyone received the supplies.
